title: 125 STS Human Performance Program
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.NATIONAL GUARD BUREAU.JFHQ USPFO OR.USPFO OR PROCUREMENT.W7NW USPFO ACTIVITY ORANG 142
description_text: The Oregon Air National Guard requires the services for Human Performance Program (HPP) supporting the 125 Special Tactics Squadron (STS). Contractors shall ensure operators are physically and mentally optimized for mission readiness and sustained peak performance, while minimizing injury and maximizing return-to-duty efficiency. This includes the following services: Physical Therapy/Injury Management, Athletic Training, Strength and Conditioning, and Cognitive Performance.A formal solicitation shall be posted at a later time to include evaluation criteria.
